home.title: Vite Extra React TypeScript
home.subtitle: SSR Starter Template
home.description: A production-ready SSR starter with TypeScript, React, Vite, Tailwind CSS, i18n, Socket.io, and Zustand — all pre-configured and ready to go.

ssr.title: Server-Side Rendering
ssr.description: Pre-rendered HTML for fast first paint, SEO, and improved performance with streaming support.

routing.title: Client-Side Routing
routing.description: React Router with SSR-compatible StaticRouter and BrowserRouter for seamless navigation.

i18n.title: Internationalization
i18n.description: Multi-language support with i18next, cookie-based detection, and server-side language rendering.

theme.title: Theme System
theme.description: Dark/Light theme with Zustand persistence, cookie sync, and SSR-compatible class toggling.

socket.title: Socket.io
socket.description: Real-time bidirectional event-based communication with automatic reconnection support.

state.title: State Management
state.description: Zustand stores with persist middleware for theme, auth, and socket state management.

about.title: About This Project
about.description: This is a demonstration template showcasing how to build a full-featured Vite + React SSR application.
about.architecture_desc: The application uses a custom Express server that handles SSR with streaming support. On the server, StaticRouter renders the initial HTML, and on the client, hydrateRoot picks up where the server left off — ensuring a smooth, interactive experience.

socket.title: Socket.io Demo
socket.description: Real-time connection status and player count synchronization.
